*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;min-height:100%}
button,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer;border:0;background:none}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",ui-monospace,monospace}
.micro{font:500 10.5px/1.2 "Geist Mono",monospace;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-3)}

#sky{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:100vh;z-index:0;pointer-events:none}
.stage{position:relative;z-index:1;min-height:100vh;container-type:inline-size;container-name:stage;margin:0 auto;transition:max-width .4s}
body[data-vp="mobile"] .stage{max-width:390px;border-left:1px solid var(--hud-line);border-right:1px solid var(--hud-line)}

/* ---------- HUD primitives ---------- */
.hud{position:relative;background:var(--hud-bg);border:1px solid var(--hud-line);border-radius:12px;backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(1.4);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(1.4);transition:box-shadow .5s,border-color .5s}
.hud::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-1px;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;opacity:.9;
  background:
   linear-gradient(var(--hud-hi),var(--hud-hi)) top left/16px 1px no-repeat,
   linear-gradient(var(--hud-hi),var(--hud-hi)) top left/1px 16px no-repeat,
   linear-gradient(var(--hud-hi),var(--hud-hi)) top right/16px 1px no-repeat,
   linear-gradient(var(--hud-hi),var(--hud-hi)) top right/1px 16px no-repeat,
   linear-gradient(var(--hud-hi),var(--hud-hi)) bottom left/16px 1px no-repeat,
   linear-gradient(var(--hud-hi),var(--hud-hi)) bottom left/1px 16px no-repeat,
   linear-gradient(var(--hud-hi),var(--hud-hi)) bottom right/16px 1px no-repeat,
   linear-gradient(var(--hud-hi),var(--hud-hi)) bottom right/1px 16px no-repeat}
.hud.ping{border-color:var(--hud-hi);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab,var(--c1) 40%,transparent),0 0 60px -10px var(--c1)}
.hud.work{overflow:hidden}
.hud.work::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:60px;top:-60px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,color-mix(in oklab,var(--c1) 22%,transparent),transparent);animation:scan 1.6s linear infinite;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes scan{to{top:100%}}
.hud-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 16px 10px}
.hud-h .micro{color:var(--ink-2)}
.hud-h .n{margin-left:auto}
.nd{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c1);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--c1),0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--c1) 18%,transparent);flex:none}
.nd.v{background:var(--c3);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--c3),0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--c3) 18%,transparent)}
.nd.ok{background:var(--ok);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--ok)}
.nd.live{animation:beat 1.4s infinite}
@keyframes beat{50%{box-shadow:0 0 18px var(--c1),0 0 0 7px transparent}}
.gt{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;height:44px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:999px;font-size:14px;font-weight:550;white-space:nowrap;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .3s}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.btn-go{color:#fff;background:var(--grad);background-size:200% 100%;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.18) inset,0 10px 40px -10px var(--c3),0 0 30px -12px var(--c1);animation:flowbg 6s linear infinite}
.btn-go:hover{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.3) inset,0 14px 50px -8px var(--c3),0 0 40px -6px var(--c1)}
@keyframes flowbg{to{background-position:200% 0}}
.btn-line{border:1px solid var(--hud-line);background:var(--hud-bg-2);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.btn-line:hover{border-color:var(--hud-hi)}
.btn .k{font:500 11px "Geist Mono";opacity:.75}

/* ---------- top bar ---------- */
.top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;padding:18px 30px;position:relative;z-index:3}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;font-size:15px}
.logo svg{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px var(--glow))}
.logo .sub{font:500 10.5px "Geist Mono";letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-3);padding-left:11px;border-left:1px solid var(--hud-line)}
.top .sp{flex:1}
.readout{display:flex;gap:18px}
.readout span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.readout b{font:500 11px "Geist Mono";color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:.06em}
.avatar{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(from 200deg,var(--c1),var(--c3),var(--c4),var(--c1));padding:2px}
.avatar i{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg)}
.crumb{font:500 12px "Geist Mono";color:var(--ink-3);display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.crumb a{color:var(--ink-2);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
.crumb a:hover{color:var(--ink)}

.screen{display:none}
.screen.on{display:block;animation:fadein .7s both}
@keyframes fadein{from{opacity:0;filter:blur(6px)}}

/* =================== HOME =================== */
.h-hero{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;padding:6vh 24px 0;text-align:center;position:relative;z-index:2}
.h-hero .micro{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.h-hero h1{font-weight:220;font-size:clamp(40px,7.2cqi,88px);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.055em;margin:18px 0 16px}
.h-hero h1 em{font-style:normal;font-weight:420;filter:var(--title-glow)}
.h-hero p.lede{color:var(--ink-2);font-size:16px;line-height:1.55;max-width:46ch;margin:0 auto 34px}
.portal{text-align:left;border-radius:22px;padding:6px}
.portal .inner{border-radius:17px;background:var(--field);padding:18px 18px 14px;border:1px solid var(--hud-line)}
.portal textarea{display:block;width:100%;min-height:96px;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;resize:none;font-size:18px;line-height:1.55;letter-spacing:-.01em;caret-color:var(--c1)}
.portal textarea::placeholder{color:var(--ink-3)}
.portal:focus-within{border-color:var(--hud-hi);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab,var(--c1) 30%,transparent),0 0 80px -20px var(--c2)}
.think-line{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:22px;margin:4px 0 12px}
.think-line .micro{white-space:nowrap}
.think-line .sh{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ink-3) 30%,var(--c1) 50%,var(--ink-3) 70%);background-size:200% 100%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;animation:shim 1.4s linear infinite}
@keyframes shim{to{background-position:-200% 0}}
.meter{flex:1;height:2px;background:var(--hud-line);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;max-width:120px}
.meter i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--grad);width:0;transition:width .6s}
#ulist{display:none;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin:0 0 12px}
.prow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--hud-line)}
.prow .sp{flex:1}
.ver{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;padding:3px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--hud-line);background:var(--hud-bg)}
.ver button{font:500 11.5px "Geist Mono";padding:6px 11px;border-radius:999px;color:var(--ink-3)}
.ver button[aria-pressed="true"]{color:var(--ink);background:var(--hud-bg-2);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--hud-line),0 0 16px -4px var(--c1)}
.compat{font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-3)}
.ideas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin-top:22px}
.idea{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--hud-line);background:var(--hud-bg);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-2);transition:all .25s}
.idea::before{content:"";width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c1);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--c1)}
.idea:nth-child(3n+2)::before{background:var(--c3);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--c3)}
.idea:nth-child(3n)::before{background:var(--c4);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--c4)}
.idea:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--hud-hi);transform:translateY(-2px)}

#concepts{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:2}
.concept{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.4);opacity:0;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:12.5px;white-space:nowrap;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,1.4,.3,1),opacity .5s,left .7s cubic-bezier(.2,1,.3,1),top .7s cubic-bezier(.2,1,.3,1)}
.concept.in{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1);opacity:1}
.concept b{font:500 9.5px "Geist Mono";letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--c1)}
.concept.flow{position:static;transform:none;opacity:1;padding:5px 9px;font-size:12px}

.builds{max-width:1100px;margin:9vh auto 0;padding:0 24px 140px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.builds .lbl{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:18px}
.bnodes{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.bnode{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-align:center;padding:4px;transition:transform .3s}
.bnode:nth-child(even){transform:translateY(34px)}
.bnode:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
.bnode:nth-child(even):hover{transform:translateY(30px)}
.orb{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,color-mix(in oklab,var(--c1) 70%,white),var(--c2) 45%,var(--c3) 100%);box-shadow:0 0 30px -4px var(--c2),0 0 0 6px color-mix(in oklab,var(--c2) 12%,transparent)}
.orb::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-12px;border-radius:50%;border:1px dashed var(--hud-line);animation:spin 26s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.orb.run{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#fff,var(--c1) 40%,var(--c2));animation:beat 1.4s infinite}
.orb.run::after{border-color:var(--c1);border-style:solid;border-width:1px 1px 0 0;animation-duration:1.4s}
.orb.fail{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#ffb3c4,var(--bad) 60%,#5a0c24);box-shadow:0 0 24px -6px var(--bad)}
.orb.dim{filter:saturate(.6);opacity:.8}
.bnode .nm{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:550}
.bnode .st{font:500 10.5px "Geist Mono";letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--ink-3);text-transform:uppercase}
.bnode .st.ok{color:var(--ok)} .bnode .st.bad{color:var(--bad)} .bnode .st.run{color:var(--c1)}

/* =================== READY =================== */
.r-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(330px,430px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:30px 64px;padding:20px 40px 150px;max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;position:relative;z-index:2}
.core{position:sticky;top:20px;align-self:start;border-radius:20px;padding:26px}
.core .badge{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;position:relative;margin-bottom:22px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#fff 0,var(--c1) 22%,var(--c2) 50%,var(--c3) 85%);box-shadow:0 0 50px -6px var(--c2),0 0 90px -20px var(--c4)}
.core .badge::before,.core .badge::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-14px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--hud-line);border-top-color:var(--c1);animation:spin 6s linear infinite}
.core .badge::after{inset:-26px;border-top-color:transparent;border-right-color:var(--c3);animation-duration:11s;animation-direction:reverse}
.core.busy .badge::before{animation-duration:1s}
.core h1{font-weight:300;font-size:44px;letter-spacing:-.05em;line-height:1}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin:14px 0 18px}
.chip{font:500 11px "Geist Mono";letter-spacing:.04em;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--hud-line);color:var(--ink-2);background:var(--hud-bg)}
.chip.ok{color:var(--ok);border-color:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ok) 35%,transparent);background:var(--ok-bg)}
.chip.next{color:var(--c1);border-color:color-mix(in oklab,var(--c1) 45%,transparent)}
.core p.what{color:var(--ink-2);font-size:15px;line-height:1.65}
.acts{display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:22px}
.acts .duo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.howto{margin-top:24px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--hud-line)}
.howto ol{list-style:none;counter-reset:s;display:grid;gap:10px;margin-top:12px}
.howto li{display:flex;gap:12px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-2);line-height:1.5}
.howto li::before{counter-increment:s;content:"0" counter(s);font:500 11px "Geist Mono";color:var(--c1);padding-top:2px}
.ask{margin-top:18px;display:none}
.ask.open{display:block;animation:fadein .4s both}
.ask textarea{width:100%;min-height:76px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--hud-line);background:var(--field);padding:12px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;resize:none;outline:0}
.ask textarea:focus{border-color:var(--hud-hi)}
.ask .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:8px}
.trace{margin-top:20px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--hud-line);display:none}
.trace.on{display:block}
.trace .th{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px}
.trace ol{list-style:none;position:relative}
.trace ol::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:8px;top:8px;bottom:8px;width:1px;background:linear-gradient(var(--c1),var(--c3),transparent)}
.trace li{display:flex;gap:14px;padding:6px 0;font-size:13.5px;animation:fadein .4s both}
.trace li .o{flex:none;width:17px;height:17px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--ok);background:var(--bg);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:9px;color:var(--ok);position:relative;z-index:1}
.trace li.now .o{border-color:var(--c1);animation:beat 1.2s infinite}
.trace li.now .o::after{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c1)}
.trace li.now .t{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ink-2) 30%,var(--c1) 50%,var(--ink-2) 70%);background-size:200% 100%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;animation:shim 1.4s linear infinite}
.trace li small{display:block;font:500 11px "Geist Mono";color:var(--ink-3);margin-top:2px}
.trace li.now small{color:var(--c1)}

.sats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:26px 30px;align-content:start;padding-top:10px}
.sat:nth-child(even){margin-top:46px}
.sat.wide{grid-column:1/-1;margin-top:0}
.sat .body{padding:2px 16px 16px}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px}
th{text-align:left;font:500 10px "Geist Mono";letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-3);padding:8px 8px 8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hud-line)}
td{padding:10px 8px 10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hud-line);color:var(--ink-2);vertical-align:top}
tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
td code,.kbd{font:500 12px "Geist Mono";color:var(--ink);padding:2px 7px;border-radius:6px;background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--c2) 10%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in oklab,var(--c2) 18%,transparent);white-space:nowrap}
tr.new td{animation:rowin 2.4s both}
@keyframes rowin{0%{opacity:0;background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--c1) 25%,transparent)}20%{opacity:1}100%{background:transparent}}
.safe{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px}
.shield{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--ok);background:var(--ok-bg);box-shadow:0 0 30px -8px var(--ok);font-weight:700;font-size:18px}
.checks{display:grid;gap:8px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-2)}
.checks div{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.checks div::before{content:"";width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--ok)}
.src{display:grid;grid-template-columns:190px minmax(0,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--hud-line)}
.ftree{padding:12px 14px;font:12.5px/2.05 "Geist Mono",monospace;color:var(--ink-3);border-right:1px solid var(--hud-line)}
.ftree div{cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.ftree .on{color:var(--ink)}
.ftree .on::before{content:"▸ ";color:var(--c1)}
.ftree .mod::after{content:" ●";color:var(--c1);font-size:9px}
.edhead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hud-line)}
.edhead .sp{flex:1}
.code{counter-reset:ln;font:12.8px/1.8 "Geist Mono",monospace;background:var(--code-bg);padding:10px 0;overflow:auto;outline:0;max-height:360px;border-radius:0 0 12px 0}
.code>div{white-space:pre;padding-right:16px;min-height:1.8em}
.code>div::before{counter-increment:ln;content:counter(ln);display:inline-block;width:44px;padding-right:14px;text-align:right;color:var(--ink-3);opacity:.6;user-select:none}
.code>div.add{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ok) 13%,transparent);box-shadow:inset 2px 0 var(--ok)}
.code:focus{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--hud-hi)}
.caret{display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1.1em;vertical-align:-3px;background:var(--c1);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--c1);animation:blink 1s steps(1) infinite}

<script>
/* ============================================================
   SKY — nebula, stars, aurora curtains, plexus web, filaments
   ============================================================ */
const stage=document.getElementById('stage'),cv=document.getElementById('sky'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const lo=document.createElement('canvas'),lctx=lo.getContext('2d');
const RM=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
let W=0,H=0,DPR=1,SX=0,nodes=[],stars=[],strips=[],mouse={x:-9999,y:-9999};
const PAL={
  brand:{aur:['#14c5e4','#2f7eef','#8c3ae9','#d623e1'],neb:['#2f7eef','#8c3ae9','#d623e1','#14c5e4']},
  polar:{aur:['#2cf5a0','#14c5e4','#8c3ae9','#d623e1'],neb:['#14c5e4','#2f7eef','#8c3ae9','#2cf5a0']}
};
const isDark=()=>{const t=document.documentElement.dataset.theme;return t?t==='dark':matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches};
const hexA=(h,a)=>{const n=parseInt(h.slice(1),16);return `rgba(${n>>16},${n>>8&255},${n&255},${a})`};

function makeStrips(){
  const p=PAL[document.body.dataset.pal].aur,dark=isDark();
  strips=p.map(c=>{const s=document.createElement('canvas');s.width=1;s.height=160;const g=s.getContext('2d');
    const gr=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,160);
    gr.addColorStop(0,hexA(c,0));gr.addColorStop(.45,hexA(c,.22));gr.addColorStop(.82,hexA(c,.85));
    gr.addColorStop(.9,dark?'rgba(235,250,255,.95)':hexA(c,1));gr.addColorStop(1,hexA(c,0));
    g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(0,0,1,160);return s});
}
function resize(){
  const r=stage.getBoundingClientRect();SX=r.left;W=r.width;H=innerHeight;DPR=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);
  cv.style.left=SX+'px';cv.style.width=W+'px';cv.style.height=H+'px';cv.width=W*DPR;cv.height=H*DPR;
  lo.width=Math.ceil(W/4);lo.height=Math.ceil(H/4);
  const n=Math.max(36,Math.min(130,Math.round(W*H/11000)));
  nodes=Array.from({length:n},()=>({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*14,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*14}));
  stars=Array.from({length:Math.round(W*H/2600)},()=>({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H*.85,r:Math.random()*1.1+.2,f:Math.random()*2+.5,p:Math.random()*6}));
  makeStrips();layoutConcepts();
}
addEventListener('resize',resize);
addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{mouse.x=e.clientX-SX;mouse.y=e.clientY});
addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{mouse.x=mouse.y=-9999});

/* anchors + filaments */
let pulses=[],thinking=null;
function anchors(){
  const m={};
  document.querySelectorAll('.screen.on [data-anchor], #concepts [data-anchor], #ulist [data-anchor]').forEach(el=>{
    const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();if(!r.width||r.bottom<-200||r.top>H+200)return;
    m[el.dataset.anchor]={el,x:r.left-SX,y:r.top,w:r.width,h:r.height,cx:r.left-SX+r.width/2,cy:r.top+r.height/2,link:(el.dataset.link||'').split(',').filter(Boolean)};
  });return m;
}
function edge(a,tx,ty){const dx=tx-a.cx,dy=ty-a.cy;if(!dx&&!dy)return[a.cx,a.cy];
  const s=Math.min((a.w/2+3)/Math.abs(dx||1e-6),(a.h/2+3)/Math.abs(dy||1e-6));return[a.cx+dx*s,a.cy+dy*s]}
const hash=s=>{let h=0;for(const c of s)h=(h*31+c.charCodeAt(0))|0;return (h%1000)/1000};
function curve(A,B,t){const[x1,y1]=edge(A,B.cx,B.cy),[x2,y2]=edge(B,A.cx,A.cy);
  const mx=(x1+x2)/2,my=(y1+y2)/2,dx=x2-x1,dy=y2-y1,L=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
  const sw=Math.sin(t*.7+hash(A.el.dataset.anchor+B.el.dataset.anchor)*9)*Math.min(40,L*.12);
  return[x1,y1,mx-dy/L*sw,my+dx/L*sw,x2,y2]}
const bz=(c,p)=>{const q=1-p;return[q*q*c[0]+2*q*p*c[2]+p*p*c[4],q*q*c[1]+2*q*p*c[3]+p*p*c[5]]};
function spawn(a,b,speed=.7,col){pulses.push({a,b,p:0,v:speed*(.8+Math.random()*.4),col:col||PAL[document.body.dataset.pal].aur[Math.random()*4|0]})}
function ping(el){if(!el)return;el.classList.add('ping');clearTimeout(el._pt);el._pt=setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('ping'),420)}

let last=performance.now(),T=0,idle=0;
function frame(now){
  const dt=Math.min(.05,(now-last)/1000);last=now;T+=dt*(RM?.2:1);
  const dark=isDark(),pal=PAL[document.body.dataset.pal];
  ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  // sky gradient
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  if(dark){g.addColorStop(0,'#02030b');g.addColorStop(.55,'#050a1f');g.addColorStop(1,'#070b22')}
  else{g.addColorStop(0,'#e6ecfa');g.addColorStop(.5,'#f1f4fc');g.addColorStop(1,'#f7f8fd')}
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // stars
  if(dark){for(const s of stars){ctx.globalAlpha=.25+.75*Math.abs(Math.sin(T*s.f+s.p));ctx.fillStyle='#dfe9ff';ctx.fillRect(s.x,s.y,s.r,s.r)}}
  // nebula + aurora into low-res buffer
  const lw=lo.width,lh=lo.height;lctx.clearRect(0,0,lw,lh);
  lctx.globalCompositeOperation=dark?'lighter':'source-over';
  pal.neb.forEach((c,i)=>{const x=lw*(.5+.42*Math.sin(T*.05+i*1.7)),y=lh*(.55+.3*Math.cos(T*.04+i*2.3)),r=Math.max(lw,lh)*(.35+.08*Math.sin(T*.1+i));
    const rg=lctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,r);rg.addColorStop(0,hexA(c,dark?.16:.10));rg.addColorStop(1,hexA(c,0));lctx.globalAlpha=1;lctx.fillStyle=rg;lctx.fillRect(0,0,lw,lh)});
  const bands=[{y:.34,amp:.07,len:.34,a:.95,sp:.22,ph:0},{y:.27,amp:.09,len:.30,a:.75,sp:.16,ph:2.1},{y:.20,amp:.06,len:.24,a:.6,sp:.27,ph:4.2},{y:.15,amp:.05,len:.18,a:.45,sp:.2,ph:6.3}];
  const narrow=W<700;
  bands.forEach((b,i)=>{const st=strips[i];if(!st)return;
    for(let x=0;x<lw;x++){const u=x/lw*6+b.ph;
      const wave=Math.sin(u*1.3+T*b.sp)*.6+Math.sin(u*3.1-T*b.sp*1.7)*.3+Math.sin(u*7.3+T*.9)*.1;
      const base=lh*(b.y+(narrow?-.04:0))+wave*b.amp*lh;
      const len=lh*b.len*(.7+.3*Math.sin(u*2.2+T*.4));
      const fl=.55+.45*Math.sin(x*.9+T*2.6+b.ph)*Math.sin(x*.13-T*1.1);
      const env=Math.pow(.5+.5*Math.sin(u*.8+T*.12+b.ph),1.5);
      lctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,b.a*fl*env*(dark?1:.6));
      lctx.drawImage(st,x,base-len,1.3,len*1.1)}});
  ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation=dark?'lighter':'source-over';ctx.filter='blur(5px)';ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.drawImage(lo,0,0,W,H);ctx.restore();

  // plexus web
  const D=Math.min(160,Math.max(110,W*.12)),lineC=dark?'150,185,255':'35,60,150';
  for(const n of nodes){
    const dx=mouse.x-n.x,dy=mouse.y-n.y,dm=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
    if(dm<200){n.vx+=dx/dm*6*dt;n.vy+=dy/dm*6*dt}
    n.vx*=.995;n.vy*=.995;n.x+=n.vx*dt;n.y+=n.vy*dt;
    if(n.x<-20)n.x=W+20;if(n.x>W+20)n.x=-20;if(n.y<-20)n.y=H+20;if(n.y>H+20)n.y=-20;
  }
  ctx.lineWidth=.7;
  for(let i=0;i<nodes.length;i++){const a=nodes[i];
    for(let j=i+1;j<nodes.length;j++){const b=nodes[j],d=Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y);
      if(d<D){ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${lineC},${(1-d/D)*(dark?.28:.22)})`;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y);ctx.lineTo(b.x,b.y);ctx.stroke()}}
    const dm=Math.hypot(mouse.x-a.x,mouse.y-a.y);
    if(dm<200){ctx.strokeStyle=hexA(pal.aur[0],(1-dm/200)*.7);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y);ctx.lineTo(mouse.x,mouse.y);ctx.stroke()}
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(${lineC},${dark?.8:.55})`;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(a.x,a.y,1.3,0,7);ctx.fill();
  }
  // anchors: tie UI into the web
  const A=anchors(),links=[];
  for(const k in A){const a=A[k];
    // nearest 2 web nodes
    const near=nodes.map(n=>[n,Math.hypot(n.x-a.cx,n.y-a.cy)]).sort((p,q)=>p[1]-q[1]).slice(0,2);
    ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${lineC},${dark?.22:.18})`;
    for(const[n]of near){const[ex,ey]=edge(a,n.x,n.y);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(ex,ey);ctx.lineTo(n.x,n.y);ctx.stroke()}
    for(const l of a.link)if(A[l])links.push([k,l]);
  }
  for(const[k,l]of links){const c=curve(A[k],A[l],T);
    const gr=ctx.createLinearGradient(c[0],c[1],c[4],c[5]);gr.addColorStop(0,hexA(pal.aur[0],dark?.55:.5));gr.addColorStop(1,hexA(pal.aur[2],dark?.55:.5));
    ctx.strokeStyle=gr;ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.globalAlpha=.12;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(c[0],c[1]);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(c[2],c[3],c[4],c[5]);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.stroke();
    // terminal dots
    ctx.fillStyle=hexA(pal.aur[0],.9);ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(c[0],c[1],2.2,0,7);ctx.arc(c[4],c[5],2.2,0,7);ctx.fill();
  }
  // pulses
  idle+=dt;
  const rate=thinking?.09:.7;
  if(idle>rate){idle=0;
    if(thinking&&A.core){for(const t of thinking)if(A[t]&&t!=='core')spawn('core',t,1.1,pal.aur[0]); if(thinking.includes('core'))links.forEach(([k,l])=>l==='core'&&Math.random()<.4&&spawn(k,'core',1.2))}
    else if(links.length){const[k,l]=links[Math.random()*links.length|0];Math.random()<.5?spawn(k,l):spawn(l,k)}
  }
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation=dark?'lighter':'source-over';
  pulses=pulses.filter(p=>{const a=A[p.a],b=A[p.b];if(!a||!b)return false;p.p+=p.v*dt;
    if(p.p>=1){ping(b.el);return false}
    const c=curve(a,b,T);
    for(let k=0;k<6;k++){const pp=Math.max(0,p.p-k*.018),[x,y]=bz(c,pp);ctx.globalAlpha=(1-k/6)*.9;
      ctx.fillStyle=k?p.col:(dark?'#ffffff':p.col);ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,k?2.6-k*.3:2.4,0,7);ctx.fill()}
    const[x,y]=bz(c,p.p);const rg=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,16);rg.addColorStop(0,hexA(p.col,.5));rg.addColorStop(1,hexA(p.col,0));
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.fillStyle=rg;ctx.fillRect(x-16,y-16,32,32);return true});
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

/* ============================================================
   HOME — live interpretation: words become nodes in the web
   ============================================================ */
const RULES=[
  [/shop|buy|sell|coin|money|econom|price/i,'ECONOMY','Coin balance'],
  [/gui|menu|inventory/i,'UI','Chest menu'],
  [/join|log ?in|first time|welcome|new players/i,'EVENT','Player joins'],
  [/daily|every day|each day|streak/i,'TIMER','Daily reset'],
  [/zone|region|protect|grief/i,'REGION','Protected area'],
  [/scoreboard|sidebar|leaderboard/i,'UI','Live sidebar'],
  [/\bmine|mining|ore\b|ores\b|break/i,'EVENT','Block broken'],
  [/mob|zombie|creeper|skeleton|drop|loot/i,'EVENT','Mob killed'],
  [/chat|swear|filter|mention/i,'EVENT','Chat message'],
  [/game|arena|king of the hill|koth|parkour|spleef|round/i,'GAME','Round loop'],
  [/admin|staff|\bop\b|permission/i,'PERM','Staff only'],
  [/config|change every|can change|let me change|edit|setting/i,'CONFIG','Editable settings'],
  [/cooldown|seconds|every \d+/i,'TIMER','Timer'],
  [/reward|kit|diamond|emerald|item|book/i,'ITEMS','Gives items'],
  [/kills|deaths|balance|save|remember/i,'DATA','Saved per player'],
  [/sound|ping/i,'FX','Sound effect'],
];
const conceptsLayer=document.getElementById('concepts'),ulist=document.getElementById('ulist'),promptEl=document.getElementById('prompt');
let concepts=[];// {key,el}
function interpret(text){
  const found=[];
  const cmds=[...text.matchAll(/\/([a-z]+)/gi)].map(m=>'/'+m[1].toLowerCase());
  [...new Set(cmds)].slice(0,2).forEach(c=>found.push(['CMD',c]));
  for(const[r,tag,label]of RULES)if(r.test(text)&&!found.some(f=>f[1]===label))found.push([tag,label]);
  return found.slice(0,8);
}
let tmr;
promptEl.addEventListener('input',()=>{stopType();onPrompt()});
function onPrompt(){
  document.getElementById('tstate').innerHTML='<span class="sh">Reading…</span>';
  clearTimeout(tmr);tmr=setTimeout(()=>update(interpret(promptEl.value)),260);
}
function update(found){
  const keys=found.map(f=>f[0]+':'+f[1]);
  concepts=concepts.filter(c=>{if(keys.includes(c.key))return true;c.el.classList.remove('in');setTimeout(()=>c.el.remove(),400);return false});
  found.forEach(([tag,label])=>{const key=tag+':'+label;if(concepts.some(c=>c.key===key))return;
    const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='concept hud';el.dataset.anchor='k'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7);el.dataset.link='prompt';
    el.innerHTML=`<b>${tag}</b>${label}`;concepts.push({key,el});
    (narrowMode()?ulist:conceptsLayer).appendChild(el);
    layoutConcepts(true);requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>el.classList.add('in')));
    setTimeout(()=>spawn(el.dataset.anchor,'prompt',1.3),350);
  });
  const n=found.length,st=document.getElementById('tstate'),est=document.getElementById('est');
  st.textContent=n?`Understood ${n} part${n>1?'s':''}`:(promptEl.value.trim()?'Tell me a bit more':'Waiting for your idea');
  document.getElementById('meter').style.width=Math.min(100,n*13)+'%';
  est.textContent=n?`≈ ${n<3?'1–2':n<6?'2–3':'3–5'} min build`:'';
}
const narrowMode=()=>stage.clientWidth<=900;
const SLOTS=[198,-18,162,18,232,-52,128,52];
function layoutConcepts(){
  const portal=document.querySelector('.portal');if(!portal||!document.getElementById('home').classList.contains('on'))return;
  const narrow=narrowMode();
  concepts.forEach((c,i)=>{
    if(narrow){c.el.classList.add('flow');if(c.el.parentNode!==ulist)ulist.appendChild(c.el);c.el.style.left=c.el.style.top='';return}
    c.el.classList.remove('flow');if(c.el.parentNode!==conceptsLayer)conceptsLayer.appendChild(c.el);
    const sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect(),pr=portal.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cx=pr.left-sr.left+pr.width/2,cy=pr.top-sr.top+pr.height/2;
    const a=SLOTS[i%8]*Math.PI/180,rx=pr.width/2+Math.min(150,(sr.width-pr.width)/4),ry=pr.height/2+40;
    c.el.style.left=(cx+Math.cos(a)*rx)+'px';c.el.style.top=(cy+Math.sin(a)*ry)+'px';
  });
}

/* idea chips + intro typewriter */
document.getElementById('ideas').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('.idea');if(!b)return;stopType();typeInto(b.dataset.fill)});
let typing=null;
function stopType(){if(typing){clearInterval(typing);typing=null}}
function typeInto(text){stopType();promptEl.value='';let i=0;
  typing=setInterval(()=>{promptEl.value=text.slice(0,++i);onPrompt();if(i>=text.length)stopType()},RM?1:22)}
promptEl.addEventListener('focus',stopType);

document.getElementById('ver').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;
  [...b.parentNode.children].forEach(x=>x.setAttribute('aria-pressed',x===b))});

/* build → converge pulses, then Ready */
document.getElementById('build').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const btn=document.getElementById('build');btn.innerHTML='Sending to the forge…';
  concepts.forEach((c,i)=>setTimeout(()=>spawn(c.el.dataset.anchor,'prompt',1.6),i*90));
  document.querySelectorAll('.bnode').forEach((b,i)=>setTimeout(()=>spawn(b.dataset.anchor,'prompt',1.4),i*70));
  setTimeout(()=>{btn.innerHTML='Build plugin <span class="k">⏎</span>';go('ready')},1500);
});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-go]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>go(b.dataset.go)));
document.getElementById('backHome').addEventListener('click',()=>go('home'));

/* ============================================================
   READY — ask for a change: real step-by-step thinking
   ============================================================ */
const askBtn=document.getElementById('askBtn'),ask=document.getElementById('ask');
askBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{ask.classList.toggle('open');if(ask.classList.contains('open'))document.getElementById('askText').focus()});
const wait=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,RM?Math.min(ms,80):ms));
let running=false;
document.getElementById('askGo').addEventListener('click',async()=>{
  if(running)return;running=true;ask.classList.remove('open');
  const core=document.getElementById('core'),trace=document.getElementById('trace'),steps=document.getElementById('steps');
  steps.innerHTML='';trace.classList.add('on');core.classList.add('busy');
  document.getElementById('vchip').outerHTML='<span class="chip next" id="vchip">v2 → v3</span>';
  document.getElementById('ttitle').textContent='Building v3';
  const t0=Date.now(),clk=setInterval(()=>{const s=(Date.now()-t0)/1000|0;document.getElementById('tclock').textContent=`00:${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}`},250);
  const plan=[
    {t:'Reading your request',d:'cooldown on /shop sell · admins can change it',ms:1300,to:['core']},
    {t:'Finding where selling happens',d:'ShopCommand.java · line 3',ms:1400,to:['src'],fx:()=>hl(2)},
    {t:'Adding a setting',d:'sell-cooldown: 10 (seconds)',ms:1200,to:['set'],fx:addSetting},
    {t:'Writing the cooldown check',d:'+4 lines in ShopCommand.java',to:['src'],fx:typeCode},
    {t:'Compiling',d:'Paper 1.21.11 · 0 errors',ms:1600,to:['core']},
    {t:'Safety check',d:'no internet · no files · no system commands',ms:1500,to:['safe']},
  ];
  for(const s of plan){
    const li=document.createElement('li');li.className='now';li.innerHTML=`<span class="o"></span><div><span class="t">${s.t}…</span><small>${s.d}</small></div>`;steps.appendChild(li);
    thinking=s.to;const targets=s.to.map(id=>document.querySelector(`[data-anchor="${id}"]`));targets.forEach(e=>e&&e!==core&&e.classList.add('work'));
    if(s.fx)await s.fx();if(s.ms)await wait(s.ms);
    targets.forEach(e=>e&&e.classList.remove('work'));
    li.className='';li.querySelector('.o').textContent='✓';li.querySelector('.t').textContent=s.t;
  }
  thinking=null;clearInterval(clk);core.classList.remove('busy');
  document.getElementById('ttitle').textContent='v3 ready · install when you like';
  document.getElementById('vchip').outerHTML='<span class="chip" id="vchip">v3</span>';
  const vl=document.getElementById('vlist');vl.querySelector('.cur')?.classList.remove('cur');
  vl.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin','<div class="vrow cur"><span class="o"></span>v3 · Cooldown on /shop sell<small>just now</small></div>');
  ping(document.querySelector('[data-anchor="ver"]'));spawn('core','ver',1);
  document.getElementById('edstate').textContent='v3 · read-write';
  document.querySelectorAll('.code .caret,.code .ai-tag').forEach(e=>e.remove());
  running=false;
});
function hl(i){const l=document.querySelectorAll('#code>div')[i];if(!l)return;l.style.background='color-mix(in oklab,var(--c1) 16%,transparent)';setTimeout(()=>l.style.background='',1800)}
async function addSetting(){
  document.getElementById('settings').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<tr class="new"><td><code>sell-cooldown</code></td><td>10</td><td>Seconds between sells</td></tr>');
  document.getElementById('setn').textContent='04';document.getElementById('fcfg').classList.add('mod');
}
async function typeCode(){
  document.getElementById('fmain').classList.add('mod');
  const lines=[
    ['    long wait = cooldowns.remaining(p, cfg.getInt("sell-cooldown"));','    <span class="k">long</span> wait = cooldowns.<span class="f">remaining</span>(p, cfg.<span class="f">getInt</span>(<span class="s">"sell-cooldown"</span>));'],
    ['    if (wait > 0) {','    <span class="k">if</span> (wait > <span class="n">0</span>) {'],
    ['      p.sendMessage("Wait " + wait + "s before selling again.");','      p.<span class="f">sendMessage</span>(<span class="s">"Wait "</span> + wait + <span class="s">"s before selling again."</span>);'],
    ['      return true; }','      <span class="k">return true</span>; }'],
  ];
  const code=document.getElementById('code');let anchor=code.children[2];
  document.querySelector('[data-anchor="src"]').scrollIntoView({behavior:RM?'auto':'smooth',block:'center'});
  for(const[plain,html]of lines){
    const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='add';anchor.after(d);anchor=d;
    for(let i=1;i<=plain.length;i++){d.innerHTML=escapeHtml(plain.slice(0,i))+'<span class="caret"></span><span class="ai-tag">Nxeon AI</span>';await wait(14)}
    d.innerHTML=html;
  }
  anchor.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<span class="caret"></span><span class="ai-tag">Nxeon AI</span>');
  await wait(500);
}
const escapeHtml=s=>s.replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>');

/* ============================================================
   screens + dock
   ============================================================ */
function go(s){
  document.body.dataset.screen=s;
  document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(m=>m.classList.toggle('on',m.id===s));
  document.getElementById('crumb').style.display=s==='ready'?'flex':'none';
  document.querySelectorAll('#dScreen button').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',b.dataset.v===s));
  scrollTo({top:0});setTimeout(layoutConcepts,50);
}
function dock(id,fn){document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;
  [...b.parentNode.children].forEach(x=>x.setAttribute('aria-pressed',x===b));fn(b.dataset.v)})}
dock('dScreen',go);
dock('dPal',v=>{document.body.dataset.pal=v;makeStrips()});
dock('dTheme',v=>{v==='auto'?document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-theme'):document.documentElement.dataset.theme=v;makeStrips()});
dock('dVp',v=>{document.body.dataset.vp=v;setTimeout(resize,420)});
matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').addEventListener('change',makeStrips);
addEventListener('scroll',()=>layoutConcepts(),{passive:true});

resize();requestAnimationFrame(frame);
setTimeout(()=>typeInto('A /shop menu where players buy diamonds and enchanted books with coins they earn from mining. Admins can change every price.'),700);
</script>
</body>

content.text:
You were right, they were generic dashboards with coloured blobs behind them. I've replaced them with one immersive concept built around your theme. It's open in the Browser pane ([aurora.html](aurora.html)).

**The sky**
- Animated aurora curtains, with a bright lower edge and rays that ripple and flicker.
- Drifting nebula clouds and a starfield behind them.
- A network of thin web lines over the whole screen that leans toward your mouse.

**The UI is part of the web**
Every panel is wired into the network with curved glowing strands, and pulses of light travel along them. Panels have thin HUD-style corner brackets so the sky shows through.

**Home: the AI reads as you type**
- A shop request is typed in when the page loads. As you type, each part the AI understands appears as a node beside the prompt ("Coin balance", "/shop", "Block broken", "Staff only" and so on) and sends a pulse into the prompt. It also updates "Understood 7 parts" and a build-time estimate.
- The idea buttons type their example in, and you can type your own text to watch it react.
- Your past builds sit below as a chain of glowing orbs you can click to go back into a project. Running builds pulse and refused ones glow red.
- "Build plugin" pulls every node into the prompt, then opens the Ready screen.

**Ready: watch it think**
- Click "Ask for a change", then "Make change". Pulses race from the plugin's card to whichever panel is being worked on, and that panel shows a scanning sweep.
- The steps tick through: reading your request, finding the code, adding a setting, writing the cooldown check, compiling and the safety check. The new `sell-cooldown` row appears in Settings.
- An "Nxeon AI" cursor types the new lines into the code. After the safety check, a v3 entry appears in the version history.
- You can click into the code and edit it yourself.

The controls at the bottom switch between Home and Ready, the brand colours and a green "Polar" aurora, light/dark/auto, and full width or 390px. I checked all of them. In light mode it becomes a pale daylight aurora with navy web lines, and at 390px everything stacks into one column.

So far this covers only Home and Ready. Is this the feel you meant? Tell me what to push further, for example a denser web, more aurora, or more motion. Once you're happy, I'll build the full Next.js app in this style with every state: Building, Failed, the install modal and the change-request modal.
